## Resume: reconcile result

**All three stages are ticked, so nothing is left to hand off.**

- **Stage 3** is the only stage stamped COMPLETE since the last resume (2026-10-09). It was implemented by plan 5.
- **No amendments.** Plan 5's `## Handoff to later stages` reads `None`, so it changes no later entry. No unticked stages remain to re-validate either way.
- **No research track** is waiting on a Ranked list, since this roadmap came from a spec.

With every stage ticked, the next step is the **roadmap-completion review** (§6). Before retiring, I re-run the gap rubric over R1–R6 on the system as it now stands, with evidence for each verdict. I haven't gathered that evidence yet. These are the read-only checks I'll run next:

```
Read  specs/parking-occupancy-spec.md                      # R1–R6 text, §2–§4
Read  specs/plans/completed/2-sensor-ingest.md             # Deviation notes, R1–R3 evidence
Read  specs/plans/completed/3-occupancy-rates.md           # Deviation notes, R4 evidence
Read  specs/plans/completed/5-occupancy-dashboard.md       # Deviation notes, R5–R6 evidence
Read  sensors/poll.py                                      # R3: was 15 min at derivation; §2 asks 5
Grep  "duplicate|dedup" in tests/                          # Stage 1 exit test
Grep  "95" in alert/dashboard code and tests/              # Stage 3 alert threshold test
Read  specs/deferred_items.md                              # if it exists: anything deferred against R1–R6
```

R3 is the row to watch. At derivation, polling ran every 15 minutes instead of 5. If `sensors/poll.py` still says 15 and plan 2 has no `> Deviation:` note, R3 is still unmet.

**How the audit can end:**

- **Every row is implemented-as-specified, or a recorded deviation.** I'll show you the table and propose retirement: move the roadmap to `specs/completed/` beside the retired spec. I won't move any files until you approve.
- **Any requirement is unmet.** It exits one of two ways: a new stage, which keeps the roadmap live, or a deliberate deferral to `specs/deferred_items.md` with a written reason. Your call per row.

Shall I run the audit?
